stories.title: Document rebase-only branch recovery

acceptanceCriteria: Block stacking in rebase-only mode and describe verified recovery
stories.testEvidence: Scratch Git recovery replayed the sole missing commit and reproduced the intended tree. Both PR spell and Git convention document the rule.

acceptanceCriteria: Require operator approval in the acting session

acceptanceCriteria: Apply consistent per-action rules in both spells and provider paths

acceptanceCriteria: Require full completion option read-back and matching scope

stories.title: Expose optional roster accent pairs

acceptanceCriteria: Validate the pair and preserve it in exported state
